name: Octavia E. Butler Landing Base
science_note: Primary EVA Habitat & Staging Zone. Flat basaltic-olivine floor unit (<4° slope), ideal for astronaut egress and rover staging.

name: Kodiak Butte Delta Remnant
science_note: Erosional remnant proving Jezero once held a lake. Key stratigraphic target for preserved ancient biosignatures.

name: Three Forks Sample Depot
science_note: NASA's Mars Sample Return depot site featuring fine-grained sulfate and clay-bearing lakebed sediments.

name: Bright Angel & Neretva Vallis
science_note: Light-toned mudstones in Neretva Vallis containing complex organic carbon compounds and mineral veins.

name: South Séítah Olivine Ridges
science_note: Coarse-grained igneous cumulate rocks altered by water, bordered by aeolian sand ripples.

name: Jezero Western Crater Rim
science_note: 3.9-billion-year-old uplifted rim rock. Extreme slopes (>22°) exceed safe spacesuit mobility limits.

name: Gale Crater & Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons)
science_note: Curiosity Rover exploration site featuring 5 km high central mound documenting Mars transition from wet to arid climate.

name: Olympus Mons Summit & Caldera
science_note: Tallest volcano in the Solar System (21.2 km elevation). Basaltic lava tubes and sheer circumferential escarpment.

name: Valles Marineris (Coprates Chasma)
science_note: Grand canyon system of Mars (up to 7 km deep). Layered wall rock reveals ancient crustal stratigraphy and recurring slope lineae.

name: Elysium Planitia Volcanic Plains
science_note: InSight Lander geophysical station measuring Martian seismic tremors and core boundary depths on smooth volcanic plains.

name: Hellas Impact Basin Floor
science_note: Deepest impact structure on Mars (-8.2 km datum elevation). Thick atmospheric column and potential glacial landforms.

name: Gusev Crater & Columbia Hills
science_note: Spirit Rover exploration zone featuring ancient hydrothermal silica deposits indicating extinct hot spring environments.

name: Meridiani Planum Hematite Plains
science_note: Opportunity Rover landing zone famous for hematite 'blueberries' and ancient acidic groundwater evaporation sequences.
